conditions.description: No navigation tool beyond the fixed host tools; the host's LSP tool is denied and the Go LSP plugin disabled.

Claude Code's built-in LSP tool, given gopls by Anthropic's gopls-lsp plugin, enabled for this condition only. The plugin is installed once at user scope (claude plugin install gopls-lsp@claude-plugins-official); the probe checks gopls only, so the wiring smoke confirms the LSP tool is in the session.

Serena over MCP in its claude-code context, its project found from the workspace, its Go language server gopls. serena project index writes the project file and the symbol cache to .serena first. The dashboard and the log window stay closed.

components.name: serena-agent
components.source: PyPI serena-agent, installed with uv tool install serena-agent==1.7.0

conditions.description: CodeGraph over MCP (serve --mcp, its own Claude Code config), the index built by codegraph init into .codegraph (codegraph index refuses a tree that was never initialised). Started as cmd /c codegraph, the npm shim found on PATH (npm's global folder is on PATH in a normal Windows terminal), because Claude Code cannot start a .cmd file without a shell. Telemetry off.

components.name: @colbymchenry/codegraph
